verdict.rationale: Modal's GPU docs show selectable current-generation GPUs: H100, H200 (via automatic upgrade or explicit pinning with `H100!`), and B200/B300 via `B200+`. They also show a previous-generation A100-40GB option, plus multi-GPU counts and fallback lists. The evidence does not show that the previous-generation options are cheaper, and the A100 is the only older GPU explicitly named, so coverage of the 'cheaper previous-generation' half is incomplete. Missing for 10: pricing evidence that older GPUs cost less, a fuller catalog of previous-generation GPUs (e.g., L4/T4/A10 class), and independent or hands-on corroboration of availability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: You can pick a specific GPU type for your Function via the `gpu` argument.
Use `gpu="B200+"` to allow Modal to run requests on either B200 or B300 GPUs.
Modal may automatically upgrade a `gpu="H100"` request to run on an H200.
You can specifically request a 40GB A100 with the string `A100-40GB`.
